title:
RUKO…
ye bike asli mein
British thi 🇬🇧
clips: Ek zamaane mein iske rider <y>aise</y> hote the 🎩
Bullet sirf bike nahi… ek <y>rutba</y> thi 😎
Shuru se: 1950s mein ye bike <y>England se ship</y> pe aayi 🚢
<y>Indian Army</y> ne order diya… <y>1955</y> mein Madras mein <y>Enfield India</y> bani
Phir aayi <r>halki, zyada mileage</r> wali bikes… Bullet peeche reh gayi
<y>1994:</y> Eicher ne company sambhali… aur bike ko <y>theek</y> karna shuru kiya 🔧
Naye young boss <y>Siddhartha Lal</y> ka faisla: focus <y>sirf Bullet</y> pe ✂️
Bike <y>nayi</y> bani… aur <y>Ladakh trips</y> ne ise sapna bana diya 🏔️
Aaj: ek saal mein <y>12 lakh+</y> bikes, <y>80+ desh</y> 🌍

Aapki dream Royal Enfield kaunsi hai?
